title: Berberine promotes hair growth by targeting Axin2 and activating Wnt/beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Cheng, Ke; Lin, Jinran; Wu, Mengyi; Wang, Jiayi; Liu, Xiao; Yang, Kai; Ni, Chunya; Liu, Qingmei; Wu, Jinfeng; Wu, Wenyu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过靶向Axin2激活Wnt/β-catenin通路促进毛发生长，虽涉及分子对接但核心为湿实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Androgenetic alopecia (AGA) is the most common type of hair loss, with high incidence of comorbidities such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance and cardiovascular diseases. Berberine (BBR) has been widely used clinically to treat diarrhea in China for a long time. Although recent studies have revealed its therapeutic potential in comorbidities of AGA, there are few reports on its regulatory effects on hair growth. PURPOSE: To explore the effects of BBR on hair loss and its mechanism. METHODS: Human dermal papilla cells (hDPCs), normal and miniaturized hair follicles (HFs) were employed to evaluate the impact of BBR on hair growth in vitro. Depilation-induced hair growth mouse model was used to find the optimum concentration of BBR in vivo. Network pharmacology, RNA sequencing, cell transfection and reporter gene assay, immunohistochemistry, and molecular docking verification were used to explore the molecular mechanisms. RESULTS: These models revealed that BBR enhanced the proliferation of hDPCs, increased the length of both normal and miniaturized HFs, and prolonged the anagen phase. In the depilation-induced hair growth mouse model and histological staining, BBR treatment significantly accelerated hair growth, facilitated the transition to the anagen phase, and prolonged its duration. Mechanistic studies confirmed that BBR promoted hair growth through regulating cell cycle, mediated by targeting Axin and activating the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. Importantly, knockdown of Axin2 reduced BBR's ability to enhance hDPCs proliferation. CONCLUSIONS: These results suggested that BBR promotes hair growth by targeting Axin2 and activating Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, presenting a promising therapeutic avenue for hair loss treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：雄激素性脱发（androgenetic alhecia, AGA）是最常见的脱发类型，常伴随多囊卵巢综合征（polycystic ovary syndrome, PCOS）、代谢综合征、胰岛素抵抗和心血管疾病等合并症的高发。小檗碱（berberine, BBR）在中国长期广泛用于临床治疗腹泻。尽管近期研究揭示了其在AGA合并症中的治疗潜力，但关于其对毛发生长调节作用的报道较少。目的：探讨BBR对脱发的影响及其机制。方法：采用人真皮乳头细胞（human dermal papilla cells, hDPCs）、正常和微型化毛囊（hair follicles, HFs）评估BBR对体外毛发生长的影响。使用脱毛诱导的毛发生长小鼠模型确定BBR在体内的最佳浓度。通过网络药理学、RNA测序、细胞转染和报告基因检测、免疫组织化学以及分子对接验证探索分子机制。结果：这些模型显示，BBR增强了hDPCs的增殖，增加了正常和微型化HFs的长度，并延长了生长期。在脱毛诱导的毛发生长小鼠模型和组织学染色中，BBR处理显著加速了毛发生长，促进了向生长期的转变，并延长了其持续时间。机制研究证实，BBR通过靶向Axin并激活Wnt/β-catenin通路，调节细胞周期，从而促进毛发生长。重要的是，Axin2的敲低降低了BBR增强hDPCs增殖的能力。结论：这些结果表明，BBR通过靶向Axin2并激活Wnt/β-catenin通路促进毛发生长，为脱发治疗提供了一种有前景的治疗途径。
